fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Mystic, the Sinkhole and the Strings", "body": "Chance opens with the line that the mystic swims in the same waters in which the schizophrenic drowns, and he places the difference in learning to tell soul level synchronicity from the kind he has heard described on the Mysterious Universe podcast, where an entity seems to pull people along for its own amusement. Allen asks who is pulling our strings and whether we have autonomy, and Chance suggests that spirit and freedom are synonymous, so a sense of being controlled may simply be a lack of inspiration. Allen adds a pun on sinkholes, picturing an old sink captioned let that sink in."}, {"title": "Fire Spinning and the Flow of Synchronicity", "body": "Chance likens a flow of perpetual synchronicity to his experience as a fire spinner, where an instinct to avoid getting burned takes over his body and he can surrender to it the way a dancer follows music while still choosing his bearing. He says trouble starts when you push too far too fast or try to make something of what is not there, and he recalls from his festival days that it works better to let what you want come to you than to go hunting. Allen links the fire talk to the fire dancer puppets in Labyrinth."}, {"title": "Initiations and the Hunger to Belong", "body": "Allen recalls a youth group initiation in a church basement, spinning with a bat on his forehead, and concludes it was never really an initiation, only a suggestion, one of many we can choose to follow or not in order to hear that we are now part of the group. Chance answers with his high school football team's ritual of downing a shot glass of atomic hot sauce, noting that it was always an offer, and he wonders how many chickens the wing tradition sacrificed. Allen extends the pattern to online challenges, which he ties to loneliness after a year of lockdowns."}, {"title": "A Deep Swim Through The Neverending Story", "body": "Chance says he had just watched The Neverending Story (he corrects that at the end of the episode), which leads Allen to explain that he recorded an audiobook of Michael Ende's novel in an ASMR voice, promising a deep swim where pearls of wisdom wait in the mud beneath choppy surface waters. They stumble over the name of the talisman, Auryn, and Chance reports drawing air over air from his I Ching deck, a gentle voice with a penetrating influence. Allen calls himself an amateur humoridian and a fundamental YouTubeist, recalling dress up videos, unboxings and the Dogma 95 and mumblecore spirit behind them."}, {"title": "Elon, Doge and Patterns That Notice You", "body": "Chance recalls that a Weaving Spiders conversation made him want to talk with Allen about the Elon Musk Saturday Night Live skit, which Chance calls one of the craziest magic spells he has seen on network television. Allen cheerfully offers a free Dogecoin themed NFT while treating the doge father as a game we all play. Chance separates video game money from Monopoly money from actual money, and links El On to Saturn and to On, which he names as the god of a sun cult at Heliopolis. Allen tells of a photographer whose horse picture caught birds forming the same horse, asking what happens when the impossible notices us."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Allen Marcus is a hermit-ec/syncromystic truth sluther. As heir-etics to the status quo reality, Allen and I take you through deep networks of neural processes and narrative pathways. In this rambling conversation, we seek to empower the theater of your imagination, and affirm your suspicions that everything is connected to everything.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Pods, Pro-Chronicity and Coincidence", "body": "Prompted by questions from the Telegram chat, the pair drift from Christian music jokes into pods, with Chance connecting Tide Pods, the band P.O.D. and a Tenacious D film as coincidences that rhyme. Allen retells the image of birds forming a horse and admits that picking the best of fifty pictures is how patterns can tempt us toward madness. Chance wonders how much of such matching is just for the experience and not a chain of evidence, then offers his own term, pro chronicity, a procreative force like two notes finding harmony so that an overtone emerges with free energy that was not there before."}, {"title": "Wordplay, Warlocks and the Occult Aesthetic", "body": "Allen plays with Discord's blurple logo, which he likens to the buttons on Mickey Mouse's shorts, while Chance reports meeting someone named Disney that very week. Allen then describes the 1980s satanic panic and, in his account, Isaac Bonewits handing out dragon cards on campuses, and a Christian entertainer's music video about a witch's invitation. Chance says he has never been a joiner, and both discuss the glamour of costume: Chance describes clothing as the layer of the aura that meets the world, and the covered face he wore at festivals while questing for strangers' needs as his synchronicity training."}, {"title": "Hikikomori and the Refused Call to Adventure", "body": "Allen describes the Japanese phenomenon of hikikomori, people who shut themselves in, as a culturally bound situation and not a curse or medical diagnosis, citing the anime Welcome to the NHK, where a volunteer sister pulls a boy out of his shell. He argues that the tribe no longer offers a ritual for becoming a man, compares the retreat to Kafka's Metamorphosis, and stresses that he speaks from a masculine perspective. Chance, reading Wilhelm Reich, adds that Reich describes armoring as the filtering between sensation and feeling, and says the problem with the yang is also co-created by the yin."}, {"title": "The Washing Machine, Reich and the Motorcycle", "body": "Allen says he cursed his washing machine and watched its timer spring snap, a story he offers to show how words may talk back to us. Chance reads this through Wilhelm Reich, who he says names two misperceptions of reality, hard mechanism and a mysticism that loses touch with consensus, and he prefers seeing parts and patterns together. Chance also paraphrases Reich's idea that a way of thinking needs less coercion the more it harmonizes with reality. Allen answers with a motorcycle that cannot stop, a metaphor for consensus reality, and Chance proposes building sails while the engine runs."}, {"title": "Artists, Algorithms and Finding the Marbles", "body": "Allen argues that false synchronicities exist, pointing to algorithmic sidebars and phones that nudge us toward a promised land, while Chance says the amusement trap may be a missing muse, and contrasts it with the artist who forges a path into the wilderness. Allen warns that denying our own creativity lets someone else create for us, and that memes can work like sigil magic. Chance agrees that people become the labels they adopt. Allen closes with the story of walking to a river and finding glass marbles, which he took as a sign to persist."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "Are we casting stones at people for breaking the mold, calling them fake when what we really mean is there is a true voice there.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Our dreams are inspired and influenced by our anxieties. And our fears, and that's why many horror movies play upon these tropes and images and themes.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I believe the better way of experiencing reality would be holistically seeing parts and patterns at the same time, not losing the forest or the trees.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "There's a motorcycle called our consensus reality, and we're all riding it together.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I also just get hung up on the word amusement. Because usually when you put a as a prefix, you're saying without that.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We live in a public Culture, the collective unconscious, which might be considered a deep underground, dark net, internet of thoughts and memories, that's being posted in real time to internet services.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "People get into a word and the word becomes their reality. And that's the first form of simulation, which means hypocrisy.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "There's an element of mimetic word magic when words that you're not familiar with begin to rise in the zeitgeist and become prominent.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The artist forges a path of their own into the wilderness and only sees ahead by the light of their own generation.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "I am awake, aware, alive for this journey, whatever it is. I will persist. My tenacity will continue. I will not give up.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "The mystic swims in the same waters that the schizophrenic drowns in.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "This is a theater of the mind, and we want to paint some inspiring images inside your mind to encourage your creativity.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I feel that philosophically there's a strong case to be made that spirit and freedom are synonymous terms.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The waters at the top of the ocean or the lake or the river are choppy, but you deep dive down into the mud, and there are pearls of wisdom there, dear listener.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Learning how to play to your own strengths and not view your uniqueness as weakness, turn your uniqueness into your weapon.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "In a materialistic world, the impossible happens and we notice it. And it notices us.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If you're doing stuff you love in your life, appreciate it. Recognize yourself for it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We are flesh and blood mortals, just like you, listener, and we're not on some higher level club.", "author": "Allen Marcus", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/d1786910-237c-4ce6-923e-ff80264a703d/ALLEN-MARCUS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
